verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI reviewer has its own noise-control features. Comment exclusions let you name situations where Graphite Agent should not comment, custom rules steer its review behavior, and the reviews dashboard reports acceptance rates, which gives a lead a way to measure how often comments are useful. There is no evidence of deduplicated comments, severity labels, or any documented or independently reported false-positive rate. Missing for 10: comment deduplication, severity labels, false-positive or precision evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of low noise.
